# What’s New in TimeVault 1.0.1
- Snapshot selections are now clearly marked, so you can see at a glance which backups are set as the older and newer comparison points. - Snapshot selection is more reliable across the browser, pickers, and custom folder choices. - Improved visibility of the Use older and Use newer controls on selected snapshot rows. - Clearer recovery options when TimeVault needs Full Disk Access to read a backup. - Comparison warnings are easier to review and dismiss.
